mapper.select: SELECT id FROM hr_training_enrollment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{identifier} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT enrollment.id AS enrollment_id, enrollment.employee_id, employee.name AS employee_name, session.id AS session_id, session.session_no, course.course_name, enrollment.status, enrollment.version FROM hr_training_enrollment enrollment JOIN hr_employee employee ON employee.tenant_id = enrollment.tenant_id AND employee.id = enrollment.employee_id AND employee.deleted = 0 JOIN hr_training_session session ON session.tenant_id = enrollment.tenant_id AND session.id = enrollment.session_id AND session.deleted = 0 JOIN hr_training_course course ON course.tenant_id = session.tenant_id AND course.id = session.course_id AND course.deleted = 0 WHERE enrollment.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND enrollment.deleted = 0

SELECT file_id, file_name, file_size, file_hash, biz_type, biz_id, create_by FROM sys_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND file_type = 'HR_TRAINING_AGREEMENT' AND deleted = 0 AND url = ''
